content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Research Scientist II (Medical) Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.all_india_institute_of_medical_sciences_: Jodhpur, Remote and rural areas of Jodhpur
MBBS/ BDS with three year's post qualification experience, OR MBBS/BDS + Post Graduate degree (MD/ MDS/ MPH) or any equivalent degree including integrated PG degree, OR MBBS/ BDS/ with PhD
Maximum 40 years (till the last date of the advertisement)

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. AIIMS/JDH/NR-Res./Adv./006 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download AIIMS Jodhpur notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other conditions: All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University and full-time Experience must be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications required for the post Candidates from Jodhpur must compulsorily attend the interview offline, in person Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification Desirable: Understanding in research methodology and administering questionnaires and conducting group discussion in community Familiarity with implementation science frameworks and with mental health interventions among school and college students

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits and is based on experience, qualifications, skill set, etc. of the candidates. Tenure: 2 months / and further till projects ends Purely temporary/contractual basis, co-terminus with the project No right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS, Jodhpur or continuation in any other project Contract service will not confer any right for further assignment or regular appointment in the institute

rows.event: Deadline to apply online (Google Form), 12:00 PM

content_sections.heading: How Will AIIMS Jodhpur Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening/Scrutiny Test (may be conducted depending on the number of applicants) Walk-in interview Screening/Scrutiny Test at the right of the Competent Authority depending on the number of applicants Online interview may be considered for outstation candidates at the discretion of the competent authority Reporting closes at 10:00 AM; no candidates entertained after that

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Reporting time for candidates starts at 09:00 AM and closing time is 10:00 AM

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application in the prescribed format Bio-data All relevant original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies regarding age, qualifications and relevant experience All essential qualification and experience certificates enclosed with the application form No Objection Certificate for persons working in Govt. or Public Sector undertaking Passport size photo on the application format

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply in the prescribed format using the Google Form at https://forms.gle/sY7jjRXFeHNbe8dG7 or by scanning the QR code on the notice. Deadline to apply online is 18/11/2026, 12:00 PM. Report at the Department of Community Medicine & Family Medicine, AIIMS Jodhpur at 09:00 AM on 19/11/2026. Submit the duly filled application in the prescribed format and Bio-data on the day of the interview. Enclose all essential qualification and experience certificates with the application form, otherwise it will be considered incomplete.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Research Scientist II (Medical).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years (till the last date of the advertisement). Relaxation: Service in other research projects Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on a case-to-case basis (Only Applicable for ICMR Project).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 80,000 + HRA (20%) per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS/ BDS with three year's post qualification experience, OR MBBS/BDS + Post Graduate degree (MD/ MDS/ MPH) or any equivalent degree including integrated PG degree, OR MBBS/ BDS/ with PhD.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University and full-time. Experience must be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications required for the post. Candidates from Jodhpur must compulsorily attend the interview offline, in person. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening/Scrutiny Test (may be conducted depending on the number of applicants). Walk-in interview. Screening/Scrutiny Test at the right of the Competent Authority depending on the number of applicants. Online interview may be considered for outstation candidates at the discretion of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tenure: 2 months / and further till projects ends. Purely temporary/contractual basis, co-terminus with the project. No right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS, Jodhpur or continuation in any other project.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Jodhpur, Remote and rural areas of Jodhpur.
